from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.5)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1.1
                y = 2.2 - i * 0.9
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section6Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # 1. Setup Layout and Titles
        self.setup_layout(
            "Bridging Derivatives and Integrals",
            [
                "- The Great Cycle of Calculus",
                "- Fundamental Theorem Connection",
                "- From Rate of Change to Accumulation",
                "- Visualizing the Inverse Relationship"
            ]
        )

        # 2. Mathematical Content - Graphing Axes
        axes = Axes(
            x_range=[0, 4, 1],
            y_range=[0, 4, 1],
            x_length=4,
            y_length=4,
            axis_config={"include_tip": True, "color": GREY_B}
        )
        self.place_in_area(axes, "B2", "F6", scale_factor=0.8)

        # 3. Define Functions
        # f(x) = x (Derivative of 0.5x^2)
        # F(x) = 0.5x^2 (Integral of x)
        func = axes.plot(lambda x: x, x_range=[0, 3], color=BLUE)
        func_label = MathTex("f(x) = x", color=BLUE).scale(0.7)
        self.place_at_grid(func_label, "A4")

        self.place_at_grid(area_label, "A6")

        # We visualize the change in area as the change in F(x)
        line_at_2 = axes.get_vertical_line(axes.c2p(2, 2), color=WHITE, line_func=Line)
        
        # 6. Animation Sequence
        self.play(
            Write(self.title),
            FadeIn(self.lecture, shift=RIGHT),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        self.play(Create(axes), run_time=1)
        self.play(Create(func), Write(func_label), run_time=1)
        
        self.play(
            FadeIn(area),
            Write(area_label),
            Create(line_at_2),
            run_time=1.5
        )

        # Result calculation text
        result_tex = MathTex(r"= \left[ \frac{1}{2}x^2 \right]_0^2 = 2", color=YELLOW).scale(0.7)
        self.place_at_grid(result_tex, "B6")
        
        self.play(Write(result_tex))
        
        self.wait(3)
